info.description:
MCP-ready business intelligence over curated intelligence records for agents, dashboards, and automated research workflows.
An **Event** is a concrete intelligence record with kind `event`. A **Signal** is a synthesized conclusion derived from Events. The internal storage word `sip` is not part of the public vocabulary.
Agent workflow: (1) listTags to discover filter vocabulary; (2) searchEvents for developments; (3) getEvent and getEventEvidence to trace source coverage; (4) searchSignals and getSignalEvents to trace synthesized conclusions.
Conventions: Auth is optional at the backend but API-key protected through the gateway. Collections use page pagination: `limit` default 20 max 100, and an opaque `page` returned as `next_page`. Empty collections return HTTP 200 with `data: []`. Missing detail resources return 404. All IDs are RFC 4122 UUID strings.
Response formats: use `response_type=json` for canonical structured application data. Use `response_type=yaml` or `response_type=toon` for token-optimized output to MCP and AI-agent clients. Public Event and Signal payloads expose flattened intelligence fields without embeddings, relation direction, or internal storage objects.

get.description:
Find Event records that match optional filters and an optional semantic query. Use this route to find concrete developments before following an Event's detail, evidence, or Signal links.
**Time**: `from` and `to` are inclusive ISO date-only bounds on record `created_at`; they are not occurrence or publication timestamps.
**Filters**: tags use fuzzy text matching. `event_types`, `categories`, `entities`, `impact_levels`, `companies`, `people`, `products`, and `regions` use exact matching after normalizing names to snake_case. `categories` is a separate category filter from `event_types`.
**Output**: Event collections contain flattened intelligence fields plus `id`, `created_at`, and `kind`; provenance fields are available on the detail route when usable. YAML and TOON are token-optimized serializations for MCP and AI-agent clients.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional natural-language semantic query. Max 1024 characters.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive created_at lower bound (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive created_at upper bound (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Restrict to Event UUIDs (CSV).

parameters.name: event_types
parameters.description: Exact Event type names in snake_case (CSV), for example policy_change,market_entry.

parameters.name: categories
parameters.description: Exact category names in snake_case (CSV), for example regulation,technology. This is separate from event_types.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Exact entity names in snake_case, matched against company or people names (CSV), for example microsoft,nvidia.

parameters.name: impact_levels
parameters.description: Exact impact-level names (CSV), for example high,medium.

parameters.name: companies
parameters.description: Exact company names in snake_case (CSV), for example microsoft,nvidia.

parameters.name: people
parameters.description: Exact person names in snake_case (CSV), for example sam_altman,elon_musk.

parameters.name: products

parameters.name: regions
parameters.description: Exact region names in snake_case (CSV), for example north_america,europe.

parameters.name: source_ids
parameters.description: Restrict to direct Event source UUIDs (CSV).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Fuzzy text match against persisted tag labels (CSV).

parameters.name: response_type
parameters.description: Output serialization. JSON is canonical; YAML and TOON are token-optimized for MCP and AI-agent clients.

parameters.description: Maximum records per page. Default 20, max 100.

get.description: Lightweight liveness probe. Use it before other tools to confirm the Espresso backend is reachable. This endpoint does not require query parameters and returns only service status.

Find synthesized Signal records with optional filters and an optional semantic query. Use this route for higher-level conclusions, then follow a Signal detail or supporting-Events link to inspect its basis.
**Time**: `from` and `to` are inclusive ISO date-only bounds on Signal `created_at`.
**Filters**: tags use fuzzy text matching. Impact levels and impacted domains use exact snake_case matching. Collection items omit provenance fields; use Signal detail when Source metadata is usable.

**Formats**: JSON is canonical; YAML and TOON are token-optimized serializations for MCP and AI-agent clients.
